full_script: Let me advise you free of charge: poverty is an economic deficiency, not a spiritual badge of honor. You see a wealthy man driving a clean German machine, and you hiss and say: 'God knows who he defrauded to buy that.' That is not moral righteousness; that is financial envy disguised as religious humility. My mentor warned me against men who celebrate empty pockets as purity. If lack of money makes you holy, then every bankrupt debtor in the village should be canonized as a saint before breakfast. Money merely magnifies who you already are. If you were arrogant while broke, wealth only gives you an executive budget to sponsor your arrogance. Stop romanticizing economic paralysis. Humble yourself, acquire marketable competence, and step into financial breakthrough. Prof Layi has spoken.
